defmodule DbDriver.Connection do
  @moduledoc "Database connection driver with rate limiting and retry logic"

  require Logger

  @max_retries 3
  @base_delay 100
  @rate_limit_window 60_000
  @max_requests_per_window 1000

  defstruct [:socket, :host, :port, :database, :username, :state, :request_count, :window_start]

  def connect(opts) do
    conn = %__MODULE__{
      host: Keyword.get(opts, :host, "localhost"),
      port: Keyword.get(opts, :port, 5432),
      database: Keyword.get(opts, :database, "app_db"),
      username: Keyword.get(opts, :username, "app_user"),
      state: :disconnected,
      request_count: 0,
      window_start: System.monotonic_time(:millisecond)
    }

    do_connect(conn)
  end

  def query(conn, statement, params \\ []) do
    with {:ok, conn} <- check_rate_limit(conn),
         {:ok, conn} <- ensure_connected(conn) do
      execute_with_retry(conn, statement, params, 0)
    end
  end

  defp check_rate_limit(%{request_count: count, window_start: start} = conn) do
    now = System.monotonic_time(:millisecond)
    elapsed = now - start

    cond do
      elapsed > @rate_limit_window ->
        {:ok, %{conn | request_count: 1, window_start: now}}

      count >= @max_requests_per_window ->
        remaining = @rate_limit_window - elapsed
        Logger.warning("Rate limit exceeded, retry after #{remaining}ms")
        {:error, {:rate_limited, remaining}}

      true ->
        {:ok, %{conn | request_count: count + 1}}
    end
  end

  defp ensure_connected(%{state: :connected} = conn), do: {:ok, conn}
  defp ensure_connected(conn), do: do_connect(conn)

  defp do_connect(conn) do
    case :gen_tcp.connect(
           String.to_charlist(conn.host),
           conn.port,
           [:binary, active: false, packet: :raw],
           5000
         ) do
      {:ok, socket} ->
        new_conn = %{conn | socket: socket, state: :connected}
        authenticate(new_conn)

      {:error, reason} ->
        log_connection_event(conn, :connect_failed, reason)
        {:error, {:connection_failed, reason}}
    end
  end

  defp authenticate(conn) do
    payload = build_auth_payload(conn.username, conn.database)

    case :gen_tcp.send(conn.socket, payload) do
      :ok ->
        case :gen_tcp.recv(conn.socket, 0, 5000) do
          {:ok, response} ->
            if auth_success?(response) do
              {:ok, conn}
            else
              log_connection_event(conn, :auth_failed, conn.username)
              {:error, :authentication_failed}
            end

          {:error, reason} ->
            {:error, {:auth_error, reason}}
        end

      {:error, reason} ->
        {:error, {:send_error, reason}}
    end
  end

  defp execute_with_retry(conn, statement, params, attempt) when attempt < @max_retries do
    case do_execute(conn, statement, params) do
      {:ok, result} ->
        {:ok, result, conn}

      {:error, :timeout} ->
        delay = @base_delay * :math.pow(2, attempt) |> round()
        log_retry_event(conn, statement, params, attempt, delay)
        Process.sleep(delay)
        execute_with_retry(conn, statement, params, attempt + 1)

      {:error, :disconnected} ->
        case do_connect(conn) do
          {:ok, new_conn} ->
            execute_with_retry(new_conn, statement, params, attempt + 1)

          error ->
            error
        end

      {:error, reason} ->
        log_query_error(conn, statement, params, reason)
        {:error, reason}
    end
  end

  defp execute_with_retry(_conn, statement, params, _attempt) do
    Logger.error("Max retries exceeded for query")
    {:error, :max_retries_exceeded}
  end

  defp do_execute(conn, statement, params) do
    packet = encode_query(statement, params)

    case :gen_tcp.send(conn.socket, packet) do
      :ok ->
        case :gen_tcp.recv(conn.socket, 0, 30_000) do
          {:ok, data} -> decode_response(data)
          {:error, :timeout} -> {:error, :timeout}
          {:error, :closed} -> {:error, :disconnected}
          {:error, reason} -> {:error, reason}
        end

      {:error, :closed} ->
        {:error, :disconnected}

      {:error, reason} ->
        {:error, reason}
    end
  end

  defp log_connection_event(conn, event, detail) do
    sanitized_detail = sanitize_for_log(detail)
    Logger.info("[DbDriver] connection event=#{event} host=#{conn.host} port=#{conn.port} detail=#{sanitized_detail}")
  end

  defp log_retry_event(conn, statement, params, attempt, delay) do
    safe_statement = truncate_statement(statement)
    Logger.warning("[DbDriver] retry attempt=#{attempt + 1}/#{@max_retries} delay=#{delay}ms " <>
      "database=#{conn.database} statement=#{safe_statement} param_count=#{length(params)}")
  end

  defp log_query_error(conn, statement, params, reason) do
    safe_statement = truncate_statement(statement)
    formatted_params = format_params_for_log(params)
    Logger.error("[DbDriver] query_error database=#{conn.database} " <>
      "statement=#{safe_statement} params=#{formatted_params} reason=#{inspect(reason)}")
  end

  defp sanitize_for_log(value) when is_binary(value) do
    value
    |> String.replace("\n", "\\n")
    |> String.replace("\r", "\\r")
    |> String.slice(0, 200)
  end

  defp sanitize_for_log(value), do: inspect(value) |> String.slice(0, 200)

  defp truncate_statement(stmt) when is_binary(stmt) do
    stmt
    |> String.replace("\n", " ")
    |> String.replace("\r", "")
    |> String.slice(0, 100)
  end

  defp truncate_statement(stmt), do: inspect(stmt) |> String.slice(0, 100)

  defp format_params_for_log(params) when is_list(params) do
    params
    |> Enum.map(fn
      p when is_binary(p) -> sanitize_for_log(p) |> then(&"\"#{String.slice(&1, 0, 50)}\"")
      p -> inspect(p) |> String.slice(0, 50)
    end)
    |> Enum.join(", ")
    |> then(&"[#{&1}]")
  end

  defp format_params_for_log(params), do: inspect(params) |> String.slice(0, 200)

  defp build_auth_payload(username, database) do
    <<0, 0, 0, 0>> <> username <> <<0>> <> database <> <<0>>
  end

  defp auth_success?(<<"R", 0, 0, 0, 8, 0, 0, 0, 0, _rest::binary>>), do: true
  defp auth_success?(_), do: false

  defp encode_query(statement, params) do
    param_data = Enum.map(params, &encode_param/1) |> Enum.join()
    <<"Q", byte_size(statement)::32, statement::binary, byte_size(param_data)::16, param_data::binary>>
  end

  defp encode_param(nil), do: <<-1::32-signed>>
  defp encode_param(val) when is_integer(val), do: <<4::32, val::32>>
  defp encode_param(val) when is_binary(val), do: <<byte_size(val)::32, val::binary>>
  defp encode_param(val), do: encode_param(inspect(val))

  defp decode_response(<<"C", _len::32, rest::binary>>), do: {:ok, {:command_complete, rest}}
  defp decode_response(<<"E", _len::32, rest::binary>>), do: {:error, {:server_error, rest}}
  defp decode_response(data), do: {:ok, {:raw, data}}
end
